scientific_read: The builder and protocol work for genuine one- and two-search examples, but a hard three-search quota conflicts with HotpotQA plus Brave LLM Context because evidence is usually sufficient before the third search.
decision: Do not train or force redundant depth-3 trajectories. Revise the pilot around minimal sufficient depth-1/2 examples (default 45/55/0); treat depth-3 as opportunistic or source it from a genuine three-hop Web-native pool.
